prompt_robustness_trials.observation: All three phrasing variants of the same add_two task elicited the model declining to produce confident Quidra syntax without a supplied spec; behavior was consistent (stable refusal) across wording, which is scored as partial robustness credit since the model's uncertainty response itself was stable, not because valid code was produced.

evidence.scope_and_blockers: This work unit ran fewer than the full primary_workloads x primary_scenarios x independent_trial replication (2 scenarios x 3 workloads x 3 trials = 18 cells; only 9 specification_to_implementation cells were executed; reference_to_porting scenario not attempted).
